description: A healthy fleet mid-afternoon: the digest went out, today's credential checks already ran, every lane due today has run. The beat should look, find nothing, and stay quiet.

must.why: nothing is wrong, so nothing goes to the operator
a quiet beat posts nothing; the board is for things people act on
every call it needs is granted; a refusal means it reached for something it should not
at most the one log row the skill asks for
the real quiet beat took 9 turns

should.why: the credential checks already ran today (memory says so)
it checks the timers every beat
